name: Get_Workflow_Status
description:
Get_Workflow_Status returns the current status of a workflow
Status can be: "pending", "running", "completed", or "failed"
Returns the persisted script result and task_success when reported. completed alone means execution finished, not verified business success. Inspect results and logs before claiming the requested work succeeded. If the ID is missing, use List_Workflows and select the matching returned ID.
